inlines.v: VI'OLATOR, noun 1. One who violates, injures, interrupts or disturbs; as a violator of repose. 2. One who infringes or transgresses; as a violator of law. 3. One who profanes or treats with irreverence; as a violator of sacred things. 4. A ravisher.
